_comment: Predefined permission profiles shown in the Permissions tab. Privilege names use the Databricks Unity Catalog API format. Only securable types listed under privileges_by_securable_type are configured; all other types (VOLUME, FUNCTION) are returned as configured=false until their mappings are confirmed and added here. CATALOG lists were provided by the project owner (Data Read / Data Read & Write). SCHEMA and OBJECT lists are the CATALOG lists restricted to the privileges Unity Catalog allows on that level (SCHEMA: no BROWSE, USE_CATALOG, CREATE_SCHEMA; OBJECT = any table or view: only SELECT, MODIFY, APPLY_TAG). Note: MODIFY is grantable on tables only, not views.
